questions.stem:
—Have you finished your homework?
—Yes, I ______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 选A。an hour ago（一小时前）是明确的过去时间状语，必须用一般过去时finished。现在完成时have finished不能与具体的过去时间状语（如ago, yesterday, last week等）连用。解题技巧：看到ago直接选过去式。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ was written by Lu Xun is very popular among teenagers.
questions.explanation: 选B。先行词是the book（物），且在定语从句中作主语，所以用which或that。who/whom指人，whose表示所属关系（谁的），均不符合。解题口诀：先行词是物用which/that，是人用who/whom，whose后面必须接名词。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old books ______ to the library tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 选C。主语books与动词return是被动关系（书被归还），且tomorrow morning表示将来时间，所以用一般将来时的被动语态will be returned。被动语态基本结构：be + 过去分词，注意时态变化。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Is that Mr. Wang knocking at the door?
—It ______ be him. He has gone to Beijing on business.
questions.explanation: 选C。根据后句He has gone to Beijing（他去北京出差了，现在还没回来），可知敲门的不可能是他。can't表示否定推测'不可能'。must表示肯定推测'must'，might表示可能性较小的推测'might'，均与语境矛盾。解题技巧：看到'去某地未回'用can't表否定推测。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: We should ______ the environment by reducing waste and planting more trees.
questions.explanation: 选A。根据句意'通过减少浪费和种树来____环境'，应该是'保护'环境。protect意为保护，pollute（污染）、damage（破坏）、destroy（摧毁）均为负面词汇，与句意相反。解题技巧：根据上下文逻辑和常识判断环保类词汇。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The ______ news that we lost the game made all of us feel sad.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据lost the game（输掉比赛）和feel sad（感到难过），可知这是'unhappy news'（令人不高兴的消息）。un-是表示否定意义的前缀。A与句意相反，C是副词不能修饰名词news，D是名词不能作定语。解题技巧：un-前缀表示'不/无'，如unhappy, unhealthy, unable等。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights when you leave the classroom to save electricity.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据leave the classroom（离开教室）和save electricity（节约用电），应该是'关灯'turn off。turn on打开，turn up调大（音量），turn down调小/拒绝，均不符合语境。解题技巧：turn off=switch off=shut off，都表示'关闭'电器类设备。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 选B。根据上下文，项目目的是帮助学生理解环保的'重要性'，因此选important。其他选项boring（无聊的）、difficult（困难的）、easy（容易的）均不符合语境中对环保项目的正面描述。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a green project called "Zero Waste Classroom". The project aims to help students understand the (8)___ of environmental protection.

Every class was asked to collect (9)___ materials like paper, plastic bottles and old books. At first, many students thought it was (10)___ and didn't want to participate. However, after our teacher explained how much waste we produce every day, we changed our (11)___.

My class set up a special corner for sorting waste. We put different bins for paper, plastic and other waste. Every Friday afternoon, volunteer students would take the collected items to the recycling center.

By the end of the term, we had collected over 500 kilograms of recyclable materials. The money we got from selling these materials was used to buy new books for our class library.

This experience taught us that small actions can make a big (12)___. We realized that protecting the environment is not just a slogan but something we can do in our daily lives.

questions.explanation: 选A。下文列举了paper, plastic bottles and old books（纸张、塑料瓶和旧书），这些都是'可回收的'recyclable材料。terrible（糟糕的）、comfortable（舒适的）、horrible（可怕的）均与这些物品的属性无关。

questions.stem: How many hours of sleep do teenagers need every night according to the passage?
questions.explanation: 选B。细节理解题。直接定位原文第二段第一句'Scientists have found that teenagers need about 8-10 hours of sleep every night.'，答案明确为8-10小时。解题技巧：细节题要注意题干中的数字、大写、特殊名词等关键词，快速在原文中找到对应句子。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Many teenagers love staying up late to play games or watch videos. However, new research shows that lack of sleep can seriously affect our health and study performance.

Scientists have found that teenagers need about 8-10 hours of sleep every night. During sleep, our brains process information we learned during the day. If we don't get enough sleep, we may have trouble concentrating in class and remembering new knowledge.

Moreover, sleep deprivation（睡眠不足）can weaken our immune system（免疫系统）, making us more likely to get sick. It can also affect our mood, causing irritability and stress.

To sleep better, experts suggest creating a bedtime routine. This means going to bed and waking up at the same time every day, even on weekends. Also, avoid using electronic devices at least one hour before bed, as the blue light from screens can prevent us from falling asleep.

Remember, good sleep habits are not just about resting your body—they are essential for your growth and academic success.

questions.stem: What does the underlined word 'irritability' in Paragraph 3 probably mean?
questions.explanation: 选B。词义猜测题。根据上下文，sleep deprivation（睡眠不足）会影响情绪，与stress（压力）并列，且与mood（情绪）相关。irritability意为'易怒'，与anger（愤怒）意思最接近。happiness（幸福）、excitement（兴奋）、surprise（惊讶）均与睡眠不足带来的负面情绪不符。解题技巧：通过并列词（and后的stress）和上下文情感色彩（负面）推断词义。

options: A. All teenagers sleep less than 6 hours every night.

options: A. How to Play Games Wisely
